notes.title: Pre-order on the Nintendo Switch is available!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/the-unexpected-quest-switch/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38754765/a1d587e128e2240e8fcee3cfc89de08d72f916fa.png[/img]

Hi Adventures!

We are happy to inform you that The Unexpected Quest will be released on Nintendo Switch on January 23rd, and now the game is already available for digital Pre-Order!

E-shop link: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/the-unexpected-quest-switch/

Happy holidays and happy gaming!

notes.title: December 15th Update & Thank you
notes.notes:
Hi Adventurers!

Just a quick message to say thanks to all for your great support since we launched The Unexpected Quest. We’ve been really pleased with all of your support, messages, and feedback on the game and it’s great to see so many people are enjoying it. 

Based on your feedback, we’ve made small fixes to the game. Please find the patch notes below.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
If the game does not find a suitable localization, the English language will be set.

Thanks for your amazing support and stay safe!

Cheers!

notes.title: The Game is releasing now!
notes.notes:
Hi Adventurers!

We hope you're excited as the game is now available for all to play! 

You also have a 7-days discount starting today with 20% off! Please spread the word about the game and share your feedback!

The game is available in English, German, Chinese and Russian! 

Pro tip for Chapter 7: if you can't find your way, then follow the sigils! 

You can also check out the launch trailer [url=https://youtu.be/UkN7rl_bxng]here[/url] or on the Steam page!

notes.title: Release date is now confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hi adventurers! 

We're delighted to confirm that the release date for The Unexpected Quest will be November 27th! 

The game will be live in the morning for Europe, late afternoon for Asia and in the night for North America! 

We hope you're as excited as we are and looking forward to playing the full game! 

Don't forget to wishlist the main game!
